heading: OpenSSH bookmarks for local agents
summary: Connect agents through saved SSH aliases and copy new client tokens from a dedicated window.
changes: Grant access to bookmarks that use OpenSSH configuration. Save access again after changes to the resolved configuration.
Copy the token before closing the registration window. PromeFTP displays it once.
Agent setup and bookmark actions have updated translations and aligned retention controls.
notice: Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon. Agent connections require trusted host keys.
